report_title: # P0029 ARC12 Compatibility Portfolio All-Training Transfer-50 Packet
claim_boundary: This source-pinned, failure-inclusive fresh-transfer packet measures the unchanged P0028 generic compatibility-portfolio controller on a newly frozen filename-only 25 ARC-AGI-1 plus 25 ARC-AGI-2 cohort. The roster was committed at ca305ef77142eeff5969ac51b64ef6afbdfb2a97 before any selected task grid was parsed, visualized, scored, or used for operator design; selection used only benchmark labels, split names, filenames, and opaque source-byte checksums. It excludes every historical import, P0013/P0022/P0026 transfer roster, and P0014/P0016/P0018/P0020/P0023/P0027 development roster; P0028 reused the immutable P0027 development roster and is therefore excluded. ARC-AGI-2 has only ten unseen evaluation filenames remaining after the prior disjoint rosters, so this new cohort is explicitly all-training-split rather than falsely claiming the former 12-evaluation/13-training mix. The live controller still receives only each task's visible demonstrations and test input. It receives no task ID, cohort metadata, GT feature contract, GT solver, historical decomposition, or test output before committing a complete grid. This fresh result cannot retune the frozen controller or its vocabulary. Any positive result is limited all-training-subset task-level transfer evidence, not an ARC-AGI-1 or ARC-AGI-2 solver claim.

implementation_reference.comparison_boundary: P0028 is exposed development evidence on a different cohort. Its 8/40 score is an implementation reference only and is not a denominator or statistical baseline for this fresh all-training-split transfer packet.

offline_diagnostic_provenance.role: P0029 carries forward the P0028 generic vocabulary and pre-beam visible-training compatibility repair unchanged. P0028's development evidence was available during vocabulary design, but no selected P0029 task payload or target was available during that work. The controller implementation imports, parses, calls, and receives none of the GT feature records or GT solver code.
